items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: And just like my Sol Feds book that I learned to sing the notes and the music too, those books are gone and you can't find them.

ctx.x: What were your exercise books that you had? Well, I had a French book that someone stole from.

It was called the Clodermier. C-L-O-U-D-M-I-E-R. It's the old French method. And it had everything in it. It had, from the beginning, the whole notes, then the half notes, then the quarter notes, and so forth and so on. And there were a lot of solos in there that were taken from Poet and Peasant and these other things like that. But this book was stolen from me and I've never been able to get another one like it. And just like my Sol Fage book that I learned to sing the notes and the music too, those were stolen…
What Sol Feds book did you use?
